harness_review.apprunner: generator stages Application construction, pre-start test configuration, child-process server startup/port handoff, and cleanup
harness_review.generator_model: yield is not merely value production; it suspends execution, preserves local state and position, hands control to the caller, and resumes on next()
harness_review.control_flow: test and apprunner alternate control like ping-pong: next(g) advances the generator; yield app/port hands intermediate state back to the test
harness_review.shared_object_before_start: the test receives the same Application object held in the suspended generator and can add_routes before process startup
harness_review.process_boundary: mp.start() launches a child process, not a thread; configuration must occur before the process-start boundary so later parent-side mutation is not relied upon for synchronization
harness_review.cleanup: final next(g) resumes after yield port, runs mp.terminate(), then normal generator completion raises StopIteration which the test intentionally ignores
